verdict.rationale: AngelList is a SaaS equity and fund platform, so API parity with the UI is a fair question. The evidence documents only UI-driven workflows (navigate, click Add, toggle settings), HRIS integrations and export files, not any public API. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no evidence of programmatic access, let alone parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
